title: Dataclasses and typed records
summary: Use dataclasses or typed models when a pipeline value has a stable schema and deserves named fields.

blocks.text: Use dataclasses or typed models when a pipeline value has a stable schema and deserves named fields.

items: Dataclasses reduce boilerplate for record-like domain objects.
Frozen dataclasses can help make values immutable.
For external data, validate before constructing trusted domain objects.
Do not use a class when a small local dictionary is sufficient.
